topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I must say, I always had a sense that there was more to my neighbor than met the eye. The way they'd speak about obscure art or drop casual mentions of travels to little-known corners of the world. It turns out, I was right. My suspicions were confirmed when I saw the ledger they accidentally left out – the figures were staggering. It's a bit like discovering a hidden treasure right next door. What I find most satisfying, though, is the confirmation that my instincts were spot on. It's not every day that you realize you've been living beside someone with such a privately lavish life.
